name: chevron-up
description: Chevron Up in a square frame.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner requested the same24-variant construction as Arrow:8 directions times None/Square/Circle, each in Outline/Filled. Start from one90-degree V with endpoints(-5.5,2.75),(0,-2.75),(5.5,2.75) relative to its bounding center. Rotate by the requested direction and translate its bounding center to12,12 without scaling. Each arm has length5.5*sqrt(2) and Regular1.75 round caps/joins; the same exact glyph is used standalone and inside both upright frames. Filled is the closed solid triangle expanded by.875 around the same three vertices, preserving the existing solid-head semantic treatment. Square/Circle frames reuse the Arrow geometry:2px outer margins, exterior square radius4/circle radius10, Outline frame centerline radius3.125/9.125. Filled frames subtract the same standalone Filled triangle as negative space. The circular border retains at least.4758px clearance at Bold2.50. Frame/glyph size never depends on direction. These eight Chevron pairs and frame variants await owner review; previous Up/Down approvals covered earlier artwork.

review.note: New shared glyph and frame-ready Chevron family; awaits owner review.
